directive:
D0 MAXIMALITY DIRECTIVE (orchestrator, after an adversarial whole-paper maximality review). The note is fully discharged and the rate min(1,t_0^{-1/2}) is SHARP for the frontier as defined -- do NOT touch the rate, the class, Theta=[-1,1], t_n=n*mu_n^2/kappa_n, the identification chain, or any existing proof that is already correct. The review found the paper NOT yet maximal in three respects. Work them in this priority order.

=== PART A (PRIORITY 1, STATEMENT-STRENGTHENING): the universal FIXED-WEIGHT-GEOMETRY converse ===

The gap. thm:oracle-score-inversion-attainment proves the UPPER bound uniformly over weight geometries, but thm:oracle-converse is a GLOBAL worst-case result proved with ONE specially calibrated finite-cell geometry. So the headline slogan -- difficulty depends on (n, mu_n, kappa_n) only through t -- is currently one-sided, and the sentence "the constants do not depend on the decomposition of t_0" reads pointwise-in-geometry while the proof does not establish that. The review judged the missing converse REACHABLE with the machinery already in the note (the likelihood/chi-square + total-variation + Tonelli argument already used), NOT a research barrier. Prove it.

The construction to use (do not re-derive from scratch; verify each step and fix anything wrong). Let (P_S^X, w_n, e_n) be ANY admissible deterministic geometry array with E_S[w_n]=1, E_S[w_n^2]=kappa_n <= k_n, 0 <= w_n <= 2k_n, and epsilon <= e_n <= 1-epsilon. Fix t_0 and set

    mu_n = sqrt(t_0 * kappa_n / n),
    p_n(x) = mu_n * w_n(x) / kappa_n.

Take p_n(x) as the conditional complier probability at X=x and split the remaining mass equally between always-takers and never-takers. Then
  - sup_x p_n(x) <= 2 sqrt(t_0) k_n / sqrt(n kappa_n) = o(1) because k_n = o(n^{1/2}), so these are valid compliance probabilities for all large n;
  - E_T[p_n(X)] = E_S[w_n(X) p_n(X)] = mu_n, hence n mu_n^2 / kappa_n = t_0 EXACTLY.
Give all compliers Y(1) ~ Bernoulli(1/2 + h) and Y(0) = 0, and Bernoulli(1/2) for the relevant noncompliers; use the SAME conditional full-data law in source and target (which satisfies both transport assumptions automatically). Then theta_T = 1/2 + h.
Conditional on X=x, h enters the source law only through the (Z=1, D=1) mixture, and its one-observation chi-square contribution is bounded by
    8 e_n(x) p_n(x)^2 h^2 / (1 + p_n(x))  <=  8 p_n(x)^2 h^2.
Since n * E_S[p_n(X)^2] = n mu_n^2 / kappa_n = t_0, the n-sample divergence is bounded by a universal function of t_0 h^2. Take |h| <= min{1/4, rho / sqrt(t_0)} and rerun the existing total-variation + Tonelli coverage-to-length step. Throughout, w_n, P_S^X, P_T, e_n, kappa_n and t_n are all HELD FIXED across the continuum in h -- that is what makes the bound conditional on the geometry.

The theorem to state (adjust the wording to whatever you actually prove): for EVERY admissible weight/propensity geometry array satisfying the envelope and second-moment conditions, the conditional oracle minimax expected-length frontier at effective strength t_0 is bounded above and below, UNIFORMLY IN THE GEOMETRY, by positive constants times min(1, t_0^{-1/2}); consequently any two admissible geometries with the same effective strength are equally difficult up to universal constants. The existing oracle attainment theorem supplies the upper half immediately.

If, on attempting it, some step genuinely fails, do NOT weaken the class or add a nonstandard assumption to force it. Report the precise failing step as an open obligation instead and leave PART C's narrowed wording in place.

=== PART B (PRIORITY 2, STATEMENT-STRENGTHENING): widen the feasible class beyond uniform cells ===

thm:finite-cell-unknown-weight-attainment currently assumes a KNOWN UNIFORM source cell law and a known constant propensity e=1/2. The cheap, honest widening is KNOWN NON-UNIFORM REGULAR source cell probabilities q_x with c_- / k_n <= q_x <= c_+ / k_n. Replace the source-cell estimator by

    mhat_G(x) = (1 / (n q_x)) * sum_i 1{X_i = x} H_i G_i,     G in {Y, D},

keeping Mhat_G = sum_x phat_x mhat_G(x). Then kappa_n = sum_x p_x^2 / q_x, with the unbiased target collision estimator

    khat_U = (1 / (N_n (N_n - 1))) * sum_{j != l} 1{X_j^T = X_l^T} / q_{X_j^T}.

The lower bound on q_x keeps the collision kernel of order k_n, so the existing k_n^2 / N_n = o(1) scale-consistency argument still applies; the source conditional-variance calculation becomes sum_x phat_x^2 / q_x and otherwise follows the current proof. Also allow KNOWN cell-varying propensity e(x) in [epsilon, 1-epsilon] (use the oracle H built from e(x); only constants change).
Do NOT attempt an UNKNOWN propensity (it needs extra work on random cell denominators and the induced scale estimator) and do NOT attempt a continuous-X sieve extension (it needs approximation conditions, transport-weight approximation bias at the weak-denominator scale, and a partition-complexity rule -- a new layer, not a generalization). Name both explicitly as out of scope.

=== PART C (MANDATORY, PROSE SYNC -- the note currently UNDERSTATES what it proves) ===

Both former open questions are now proved theorems, but the prose still calls them open. Fix ALL of the following; the D0-RENDER stage emits prose verbatim, so stale text ships as a false statement about the paper's own contents.

- tldr: it still calls score inversion and finite-cell weight learning remaining questions. Replace with: the oracle converse and a single all-strength oracle score-inversion sequence are MATCHED, and unknown target cell weights cost no minimax order on N_n.
- project_justification "fill": "the two open questions" is obsolete. State that the paper proves the oracle lower AND upper frontiers and proves no order loss from target-cell weight estimation on N_n; name the remaining structural issues (fixed-geometry converse if PART A fails; feasibility beyond finite cells).
- related_work: not factually stale but it under-communicates. Add a closing sentence distinguishing this paper's MATCHED oracle frontier and its finite-cell FEASIBLE frontier from the cited coverage-only / regular-asymptotic results.
- honest_scope: this is the worst passage. It currently lists uniform score calibration, matching all-regime oracle attainment, and finite-cell weight-learning attainment as OPEN; all three are theorems. Rewrite to state what is proved (identification, forced compactness, the matched oracle frontier, matched feasible finite-cell weight learning; the oracle upper bound is geometry-uniform) and what is not (if PART A fails: the converse is global worst-case rather than conditional on every fixed geometry; no feasible claim beyond the finite-cell class).
- technical_internal_limitation: it references "Open-ended Question 1", which no longer exists. If PART A succeeds this section largely disappears; if it fails, restate it as the fixed-geometry gap.
- def:inversion-handle: it says the procedure orthogonalizes a two-sample representation. The proved oracle procedure uses a source IPW score and an empirical source second moment; the target sample does not enter once w is known. Describe the estimator ACTUALLY proved.
- def:geometry-handle: it describes coupling source moments with target multinomial moments, an analysis no theorem performs. Either delete it or replace it with the PART A fixed-geometry construction.
- def:least-favorable-witness: obsolete. It describes a two-point "b delta_n" construction, but the converse proof uses the continuum h in [-H(t_0), H(t_0)]. Replace it with the continuum Q_{n,h} construction and REMOVE delta_n from the symbol inventory. Also remove the now-unused Open-ended Question theorem environment.
- Add the missing per-result Justification / Gap / Consumer riders to BOTH attainment theorems (the other results have them). Oracle attainment: one compact score inversion is honest and order-optimal simultaneously over all fixed strength thresholds; gap = feasible learning of w outside structured models. Finite-cell attainment: target multinomial weight learning costs no minimax order on N_n; gap = extension beyond known regular source cells / known assignment propensity.

=== PART D (MANDATORY, REMOVE OVERCLAIMS) ===

- tldr says "no favorable allocation can evade" the converse. That is a pointwise-in-geometry reading the current global result does not support. If PART A lands, this becomes true and may stay; if PART A does NOT land, replace it with: a least-favourable allocation yields a lower frontier indexed by t_n, while the upper bound is uniform over allocations.
- thm:oracle-converse's sentence "the constants do not depend on the decomposition of t_0" is harmless at the global V* level but misleading read pointwise. If PART A does not land, limit it explicitly to the global least-favourable frontier.
- prop:no-shift-reduction currently says "hence the frontier specializes". Only the INDEX specializes: a two-sided minimax frontier restricted to w == 1 is not established by the present finite-cell converse. Say "hence the effective-strength index specializes" -- unless PART A lands, which makes the two-sided reading correct.
- thm:oracle-score-inversion-attainment's existing caveat sentence is ACCURATE and must remain until PART A lands; if PART A lands, replace it with the two-sided fixed-geometry conclusion.
- t_c: describe it as an ORDER-ONE normalization, not a sharply identified critical constant; the paper proves an order-one elbow, not an exact phase-transition location.
- "uninformative": the theorem proves NONVANISHING expected length, not that every honest set approaches the full diameter 2. Say what is proved.
- V*(t_0) is defined by n -> infinity at each FIXED t_0. Do not describe the all-t_0 simultaneity as a joint moderate-deviation theorem over moving thresholds t_{0,n}; it is not one.
- Do not rhetorically conflate the ORACLE frontier with a feasible general-model frontier. Feasibility is proved only on N_n (widened per PART B).

=== PART E (EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE THIS ROUND) ===

Do NOT spend this round chasing sharp constants. The review confirms C_0 and c_0 are crude (|H| <= 1/epsilon giving epsilon^{-2}; Chebyshev calibration giving alpha^{-1/2}; loose collision-U-statistic variance counting) and routinely improvable, but that the gap is ordinary order-level minimax slack and would not change the paper's standing. Fixing PART A and PART B is worth far more. Just make sure no prose markets the displayed constants as practically calibrated or near-optimal.
